description_en: Upgrades the database kernel of an instance
name: UpgradeKernelVersion

parameters.help_en:
The cloud product type identifier. Valid values:

5: RDS.
8: POLARDB.
27: PolarDBX2.

If you specify both ProductId and ProductCode, the values must correspond to each other
parameters.help_zh: 云产品类型标识。5：RDS；8：POLARDB；27：PolarDBX2。与 ProductCode 同时指定时应对应
parameters.name: product_id

parameters.help_en: The cloud product code. Column encryption supports RDS, POLARDB, and PolarDBX2. If you also specify ProductId, the two values must correspond to each other
parameters.help_zh: 云产品编码。列加密支持 RDS、POLARDB、PolarDBX2；如同时传入 ProductId，二者必须对应
parameters.name: product_code

parameters.help_en: The database instance identity. You can obtain this value from Items[].InstanceId returned by ListDataMaskingInstances
parameters.help_zh: 数据库实例标识，可从 ListDataMaskingInstances 的 Items[].InstanceId 获取
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The time at which the kernel upgrade is performed. Valid values:

Immediate: The upgrade is performed immediately.
MaintainTime: The upgrade is performed during the maintenance window.
SpecifyTime: The upgrade is performed at a specified time.

PolarDB-X 2.0 does not support SpecifyTime
parameters.help_zh: 内核升级的执行时机。Immediate：立即执行；MaintainTime：维护窗口执行；SpecifyTime：指定时间执行。PolarDB-X 2.0 不支持 SpecifyTime
parameters.name: upgrade_time

parameters.help_en: The specified upgrade time. This value is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds since 1970-01-01 00:00:00 UTC. Specify this parameter only when UpgradeTime is set to SpecifyTime. The value must be later than the current time
parameters.help_zh: 指定升级时间。自 1970-01-01 00:00:00 UTC 起的 Unix 时间戳，单位为毫秒。仅 UpgradeTime=SpecifyTime 时填写，且必须晚于当前时间
parameters.name: switch_time

parameters.help_en: The target kernel version. You can obtain this value from KernelVersions[].KernelVersion returned by ListMiniEngineVersions
parameters.help_zh: 目标内核版本，从 ListMiniEngineVersions 的 KernelVersions[].KernelVersion 获取
parameters.name: kernel_version

parameters.help_en:
The language of the response description. Valid values:

zh: Chinese.
en: English
parameters.help_zh: 响应说明的语言。zh：中文；en：英文
parameters.name: lang

RequestId.description_en: The request ID, which can be used to locate this API call
RequestId.description_zh: 请求标识，可用于定位本次 API 调用
